progress.title: Project loader (xcodeproj, xcworkspace, xcconfig, schemes → PIF)
Build driver (Swift Build on Linux, Swift/ObjC/C/C++, pods, SwiftPM, xcframeworks)
Extensions, App Clips, widgets, watch targets
Device workflow (install, launch, XCTest on device)
Rare file types (intents, SceneKit, texture atlases)
Metal and CoreML (Wine-hosted tools, runtime fallbacks)
Verification harness (corpus, macOS reference builds, nomac verify)

apps.name: Retro Rampage
apps.notes: Ray-casting game: an app, two embedded framework targets and a unit-test bundle in one project with no package dependencies. First loader milestone. Deployment target 11.0 is below Xcode 27's minimum, so the build reference raises it to 15.0.

apps.name: Tofu Authenticator
apps.notes: Small UIKit app with no shared schemes (xcodebuild autocreates them), an xcconfig base configuration, [sdk=] conditional settings and a git-based script phase.

apps.name: Flappy Fly Bird
apps.notes: SpriteKit and GameplayKit game: two asset catalogs, sprite atlases and SpriteKit scene files. The README restricts the art and audio to non-commercial use; nomac only builds it.

apps.name: UnCloudNotes
apps.notes: Core Data migration sample: four model versions and two mapping models, plus storyboards. The momc replacement's main reference.

apps.name: Go Map!!
apps.notes: OpenStreetMap editor: mixed Swift and Objective-C, 17 storyboards, 18 string catalogs, a photo-share extension and a widget. Its deployment target 13.0 is below Xcode 27's minimum, so the build reference raises it to 15.0. B-098: pinned to the parent of be5be6b, which adopted `reservedRegions` and `verticalBarEdge` (not in Xcode 27.0's SDK); the deployment targets below Xcode 27's minimum (12.0, 13.0) are raised to 15.0 in the project by a prepare step, replacing a command-line setting that also lowered the iOS 16.6 widget and broke its `DynamicIslandExpandedContentBuilder`.

apps.name: Ice Cubes
apps.notes: SwiftUI Mastodon client built from 13 local Swift packages, with 7 synchronized folder groups and four extensions. Its base xcconfig is created from the committed template, as the README instructs. B-098: pinned to the parent of 5c91bd2, which adopted `axisBehavior`, an API Xcode 27.0's SDK does not have: the newest commit that builds with Xcode 27.0.

apps.name: NetNewsWire
apps.notes: RSS reader whose iOS and macOS apps share one project. All settings live in 22 xcconfig files attached through synchronized folders (objectVersion 76). A script phase runs a Swift script on the host. The secrets module needs its generated SecretKey file before it compiles. The prepare step runs the schemes' build pre-action, buildscripts/updateSecrets.sh, which writes the Secrets package's SecretKey.swift from its gyb template, with empty values when no secrets are set: Xcode compiles a package source a pre-action writes only from the next build on (scheme_action_experiments.py), so the reference is of a checkout built before.

apps.name: Swiftfin
apps.notes: Jellyfin client for iOS and tvOS with 41 pinned packages, a local Swift macro package (host-built compiler plugin) and a host Swift script phase.

apps.name: Mastodon
apps.notes: Official Mastodon client. No Package.resolved is committed, so package versions float; the reference records what Xcode resolved. B-098: pinned to its newest commit of 2026-10-30; the floating Nuke of the earlier capture did not compile with Swift 6.4.

apps.name: Corona-Warn-App
prepare: perl -pi -e 's/let nextAction = \{ \[weak self\] in/let nextAction: CompletionVoid = { [weak self] in/' src/xcode/ENA/ENA/Source/Scenes/ExposureSubmission/ExposureSubmissionCoordinator.swift
apps.notes: Germany's exposure-notification app (archived in 2023): a three-project workspace with [sdk=] and [arch=] conditional settings. B-098: archived; a prepare patch adapts four files to Swift 6.4 and the iOS 27 SDK (Foundation's `Data.bytes` is a `RawSpan` now and hides the dependency's `[UInt8]` one; one closure needs its declared type).

apps.name: Wikipedia
apps.notes: Large mixed Objective-C/Swift app with an embedded framework, eight Core Data models, many localizations and 14 shared schemes. References OpenSourceDebug.xcconfig, which is not committed, and runs a committed macOS-only tool in a script phase.

apps.name: Pocket Casts
apps.notes: Podcast player with iOS, watchOS and tvOS apps, an App Clip, intents and 49 synchronized folder groups. Script phases expect `make install_dependencies`. B-098: pinned to the parent of 3546d04, which adopted `UIArrangementViewController` (not in Xcode 27.0's SDK); credentials as the README's `make external_contributor` writes them (the template with its placeholders emptied), so no a8c secrets are needed.

apps.notes: Kickstarter's app: several embedded frameworks and an Apollo GraphQL code-generation target. `make bootstrap` creates configuration files from *.example templates. B-098: `make bootstrap`'s fallback without the private native-secrets repository: Configs/Secrets.swift.example copied where the Makefile copies it, Firebase's mock GoogleService-Info.plist in the three Firebase folders the project names, and bin/firebase-crashlytics-run.sh without its validate and upload calls (its upload-symbols is an x86_64 executable, which needs Rosetta), so the Crashlytics phase does nothing and nothing is uploaded.

apps.name: Signal
apps.notes: Signal messenger: the CocoaPods sandbox lives in a git submodule, so Pods.xcodeproj and the Pods-*.xcconfig base configurations come from that submodule.

apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.notes: Home Assistant companion: iOS, watchOS and Mac Catalyst, 20 targets, 106 synchronized folder groups and intent definitions. Its README requires Xcode 27. B-098: the earlier reference had no build (captured with --skip-build); its build takes over an hour on a loaded Mac.

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.notes: Game-streaming client written in Objective-C and C (moonlight-common-c submodule), with Core Data and storyboards for iOS and tvOS. B-098: the project names /Applications/Xcode.app's toolchain headers; where Xcode.app is another Xcode, its SwiftBridging module map clashes with the building Xcode's, so a prepare step points that search path at $(DEVELOPER_DIR), what it is on the author's machine.

apps.name: Firefox for iOS
apps.notes: Firefox: 23 targets with static libraries and many extensions. bootstrap.sh needs Node.js for the bundled user scripts. Its package macros are not approved on a fresh Mac, so the build reference passes -skipMacroValidation, as swiftfin's does. B-098: built in `Debug`, the configuration its Fennec scheme uses (with `-configuration Fennec`, which the project lacks, xcodebuild split the products and ActionExtension could not see ActionExtensionKit, B-050), pinned to the parent of da88ac4, which adopted `UIVerticalBarBehavior` (not in Xcode 27.0's SDK).

apps.name: Mattermost (React Native)
prepare: perl -pi -e 's/if let subtitle = subtitle \{/if #available(iOS 16.0, *), let subtitle = subtitle {/' node_modules/expo-router/ios/LinkPreview/LinkPreviewNativeActionView.swift
cp node_modules/@mattermost/compass-icons/font/compass-icons.ttf assets/fonts/ && node scripts/generate-assets.js && node scripts/generate-compass-glyph-map.mjs
apps.notes: React Native app: the workspace and Pods project exist only after npm and CocoaPods have run. Its Pods' deployment target 9.0 is below Xcode 27's minimum, so the build reference raises it to 15.0. B-098: the app's own setup applies patches/ratex-react-native+0.1.4.patch (`npx patch-package`, which `npm ci --ignore-scripts` skips; without it two Pods targets write `ratex.h`) and copies the compass-icons font and generated assets as scripts/postinstall.sh does; the Pods' and app's deployment targets below Xcode 27's minimum are raised to 15.0 in the projects, replacing a command-line setting that also lowered ExpoRouter (iOS 16 APIs). expo-router 55.0.14 (also at main of 2026-11-02) sets a menu action's `subtitle`, iOS 16 only in Xcode 27.0's SDK, from a target of iOS 15.1; a prepare step puts it under `#available(iOS 16.0, *)`.

apps.name: Flutter platform_channels sample
apps.notes: Flutter iOS shell: Generated.xcconfig and the Flutter framework exist only after `flutter build ios --config-only`.
